description: This file implements permission management functions for Feishu within a plugin system, including listing, adding, and removing members, as well as registering the permission tool with the plugin API.

methods.name: listMembers
methods.description: Lists members with specific permissions in a Feishu drive item.

methods.name: addMember
methods.description: Adds a member with specified permissions to a Feishu drive item.

methods.name: removeMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a Feishu drive item.
